labels.shortDescription: Save refused: the list is not one the page can change
labels.value: That list cannot be changed here. Reload the page.

labels.shortDescription: Save refused: the row is no longer in the list
labels.value: That row is no longer in the list. Click Check again to refresh it.

labels.shortDescription: Save refused: the row ships with BarnCRM; {0} is the row
labels.value: {0} ships with BarnCRM and cannot be changed here.

labels.value: Keep the name to 40 characters or fewer.

labels.value: {0} is not a choice in the {1} list on {2}. Add it in Setup (Object Manager, {2}, Fields, {1}), then save again.

labels.shortDescription: Save refused: another active row uses it; {0} value, {1} row name
labels.value: {0} already has an active row, {1}. Only one active row can use it.

labels.shortDescription: Save refused by Salesforce before it started
labels.value: Salesforce did not accept the change, so nothing was saved. If BarnCRM was installed as a package, turn on Deploy Metadata from Non-Certified Package Versions via Apex in Setup (Apex Settings), then save again. The Error Log has the details.

labels.shortDescription: Error Log: the background save failed; {0} row name, {1} reason
labels.value: The change to {0} was not saved: {1}

labels.shortDescription: Error Log entry: the background save failed with no reason given
labels.value: Salesforce gave no reason. Try again, and if it fails again, make the change in Setup.

labels.shortDescription: Custom metadata page: the list could not be read
labels.value: The list could not be read. Reload the page, and if it fails again, check the Error Log.

labels.shortDescription: Custom metadata page: the save could not be started
labels.value: The change could not be saved. Nothing was changed. Try again, and if it fails again, check the Error Log.

labels.shortDescription: Custom metadata page: heading for the relationship types list
Custom metadata page: what the relationship types list is for
labels.value: What the other side of a relationship becomes. Add a choice to the Type list on a relationship in Setup first, and add both sides of a pair.

labels.shortDescription: Custom metadata page: the user lacks Manage BarnCRM Metadata
labels.value: You need the BarnCRM Metadata Admin permission set to change custom metadata. Ask your administrator to add it.

labels.value: Related records whose values pair people or households as likely duplicates, in the duplicate scan and in imports. A source whose object is not in this org does nothing. A shipped source can be archived and restored.

labels.value: {0} on {1} is not a lookup. The parent field has to link each value to its person, household or Individual.

labels.shortDescription: Match source save refused: an address source has no postal code field
labels.value: An address source needs a postal code field: the street is compared together with it.
